free_tier.stated: 20 GB storage quota per account. Items 500, files per item 500, collections 100, projects 100.

retention.stated: Stable commercial service (Digital Science); the binding constraint is the 20 GB pool, and published items are permanent/citable, so it behaves more like a publication endpoint than a bucket.

egress.terms: Free and CDN-friendly. Download path: ndownloader.figshare.com -> 302 -> S3 object (Server: AmazonS3), with Accept-Ranges/Content-Range exposed. No egress metering on free accounts.

tooling: figshare REST API v2 (live: GET api.figshare.com/v2/articles -> 200 JSON; per-file download_url at ndownloader.figshare.com). OAI-PMH available. figshare Python client (official, github.com/figshare/figshare-python). No rclone backend.
chaining: 20 GB x unlimited free accounts. Weak multiplication within an account: the 20 GB is a single pool and the 500-item cap binds long before the bytes do at 20 GB/item.
limits_note: 20 GB total storage and 20 GB max single file; 500 items, 500 files per item, 50 versions; virus scan only up to 10 MB. Exceeding 20 GB requires figshare+ (paid) or an institutional subscription.
reliability_note: Stable commercial service (Digital Science); the binding constraint is the 20 GB pool, and published items are permanent/citable, so it behaves more like a publication endpoint than a bucket.
